entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-09
entry.content:

  • Annotate unsupported APIs in Serialization #118556
    Future
  • Can .NET AOT write a custom .NET host? #118554
  • Feature for disabling specific runtimes #118553
  • Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory.MemoryCache post-eviction callbacks cause thread pool queueing #118552

Closed

  • .NET Standard RuntimeInformation doesn't have RuntimeIdentifier property #118555
  • `WasmBootConfigFileName` doesn't work with WasmAppBuilder without additional configuration #117900
    Future
  • [WASM] - Cache never used when dotnet is executed from within a web worker #97787
    Future
  • WebAssembly SDK - Allow customising output path for WASM output files #118145
    10.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Add string.Capitalize() to System.String for Title-Casing #117509
